meta.name: trojan_horse_in_troy
meta.prompt: The Trojan horse in Troy, right before the soldiers emerge.

programs.brief: A colossal hollow wooden horse built of dark oak and weathered spruce timbers on massive wooden wheel-skids, towering within the Trojan city plaza with rope rigging and subtle concealed trapdoor seams where Greek warriors hide inside.
An abandoned Achaean siege engine frame left in the coastal dunes, weathered timber beams, broken wheels, and scattered shields.

tokens.terrain: a walled citadel on a rise overlooking the Aegean shore and the coastal plain
tokens.icons: the colossal wooden horse brought within the Skaian gates; towering stone circuit walls with defensive bastions; Priam's royal megaron dominating the acropolis; abandoned Achaean siege lines and distant beached galleys
tokens.event_direction: soldiers concealed inside the hollow wooden horse preparing to emerge and open the gates to the returning Greek fleet
